# Every Plan 0006 source leaf, its owning parent, and where it lives.
#
# Written independently of the module declarations so the two can disagree.
# A leaf that is declared and absent, present and undeclared, owned twice, or
# ordered differently under the command family is a finding rather than a
# detail the checker forgives.
